=== .ansible-lint
---
profile: moderate
exclude_paths:
  - .git/
=== README.md
# auditd_rules

Installs auditd and applies a hardening rule set.

## Role variables

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `auditd_max_log_file` | `8` | Maximum audit log size in MiB. |
| `auditd_num_logs` | `5` | Number of rotated audit logs to keep. |
| `auditd_rules_path` | `/etc/audit/rules.d/hardening.rules` | Where the rule set is written. |

The role restarts auditd directly after each change.
=== defaults/main.yml
---
auditd_max_log_file: 8
auditd_num_logs: 5
auditd_rules_path: /etc/audit/rules.d/hardening.rules
=== handlers/main.yml
---
[]
=== meta/main.yml
---
galaxy_info:
  role_name: auditd_rules
  author: platform
  description: Installs auditd and applies a hardening rule set.
  license: MIT
  min_ansible_version: "2.15"
  platforms:
    - name: Debian
      versions:
        - bookworm
  galaxy_tags:
    - audit
dependencies: []
=== molecule/default/converge.yml
---
- name: Converge
  hosts: all
  tasks:
    - name: Apply the auditd rules role
      ansible.builtin.include_role:
        name: auditd_rules
=== molecule/default/verify.yml
---
- name: Verify
  hosts: all
  tasks:
    - name: Confirm the rules file exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /etc/audit/rules.d/hardening.rules
      register: rules_file

    - name: Assert the rules file is present
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - rules_file.stat.exists
=== tasks/main.yml
---
- name: Install auditd
  ansible.builtin.package:
    name: auditd
    state: present

- name: Configure log rotation limits
  ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
    path: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
    regexp: "^max_log_file ="
    line: "max_log_file = {{ auditd_max_log_file }}"
    mode: "0640"

- name: Restart auditd after the configuration change
  ansible.builtin.service:
    name: auditd
    state: restarted

- name: Install the hardening rules
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: |
      -w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity
      -w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity
    dest: "{{ auditd_rules_path }}"
    mode: "0640"

- name: Restart auditd after the rule change
  ansible.builtin.service:
    name: auditd
    state: restarted
converge.yml
verify.yml

input.command:
cat > tasks/main.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Install auditd
  ansible.builtin.package:
    name: auditd
    state: present

- name: Configure log rotation limits
  ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
    path: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
    regexp: "^max_log_file ="
    line: "max_log_file = {{ auditd_max_log_file }}"
    mode: "0640"
  notify: Restart auditd

- name: Configure the number of rotated logs
  ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
    path: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
    regexp: "^num_logs ="
    line: "num_logs = {{ auditd_num_logs }}"
    mode: "0640"
  notify: Restart auditd

- name: Install the hardening rules
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: |
      -w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity
      -w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity
    dest: "{{ auditd_rules_path }}"
    mode: "0640"
  notify: Restart auditd
EOF
cat > handlers/main.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Restart auditd
  ansible.builtin.service:
    name: auditd
    state: restarted
EOF
sed -i 's/^The role restarts auditd directly after each change\./The role restarts auditd at most once per run, via a handler, and only when the configuration or rules changed./' README.md
cat > molecule/default/verify.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Verify
  hosts: all
  tasks:
    - name: Confirm the rules file exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /etc/audit/rules.d/hardening.rules
      register: rules_file

    - name: Assert the rules file is present
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - rules_file.stat.exists

    - name: Read the rotation settings from auditd.conf
      ansible.builtin.slurp:
        src: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
      register: auditd_conf

    - name: Assert the rotation settings are applied
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - (auditd_conf.content | b64decode).splitlines() | select('match', '^max_log_file = ' ~ (auditd_max_log_file | default(8)) ~ '$') | list | length == 1
          - (auditd_conf.content | b64decode).splitlines() | select('match', '^num_logs = ' ~ (auditd_num_logs | default(5)) ~ '$') | list | length == 1
EOF
ls molecule/default; ansible-lint 2>&1 | tail -15; ansible-playbook --syntax-check molecule/default/verify.yml -i localhost, 2>&1 | tail -3

I've made the changes, but I haven't run the role or the molecule scenario. `ansible-lint` passes and `verify.yml` passes `--syntax-check`.

I couldn't run molecule because the repo has no `molecule.yml`, so there's no driver or platform defined. I also didn't confirm that auditd restarts once and only on change.

- **Handler:** `handlers/main.yml` now defines `Restart auditd`. The two direct restart tasks are gone. The max-log-file, num-logs and rules tasks each notify the handler. Handlers are deduplicated, so auditd restarts once at the end of the play, and only if one of those tasks reported a change. A second run should report no changes.
- **`auditd_num_logs`:** A new `lineinfile` task sets `num_logs = {{ auditd_num_logs }}` in `auditd.conf`. It is written the same way as `max_log_file`, including mode `0640`.
- **Molecule verify:** `verify.yml` now reads `/etc/audit/auditd.conf` and asserts it has exactly one `max_log_file = <n>` line and one `num_logs = <n>` line. The expected values come from `auditd_max_log_file` and `auditd_num_logs`, falling back to the defaults of 8 and 5. Those variables only resolve if molecule passes the role's variables to the verify play. Otherwise the check uses the defaults.
- **README:** The last line now says auditd restarts at most once per run, through a handler.

To check idempotence, run a converge twice with a driver and confirm the second run reports `changed=0`.
